method: Unedited production-browser screenshots and native Playwright video recordings, transcoded to silent H.264 MP4 and GIF. No hover, video seeking, injected animation state or CSS replacement. Reduced-motion full-page views are explicitly separate static layout evidence. Chromium uses SwiftShader software WebGL; this is not a physical-device or hardware GPU performance benchmark.
